zh.title: Pilatus PC-12 PRO 的 Safety Autoland 取得 EASA 與 FAA 認證
zh.summary: Pilatus 公布雙重認證，PC-12 PRO 可在飛行員失能時執行緊急自動降落。
body: Pilatus 於 2026 年 9 月 24 日宣布，PC-12 PRO 的 Safety Autoland 已取得歐洲 EASA 及美國 FAA 認證。該機採用 Garmin G3000 PRIME 整合式駕駛艙。
系統可由按鈕啟動，或在偵測飛行員不活動時介入，評估天氣、航機狀態、導航資料及燃油，選擇合適機場與避開地形的航路。
自動降落過程涵蓋襟翼、起落架、燈光、除冰與無線電通訊。Pilatus 表示，認證飛行測試涵蓋從啟動到降落、通訊及引擎關閉的完整程序；本次消息為系統認證，並非全機隊改裝完成。

en.title: Pilatus PC-12 PRO Safety Autoland gains EASA and FAA certification
en.summary: Pilatus announces dual-authority approval for its pilot-incapacitation emergency landing system.
body: Pilatus announced on September 24, 2026 that Safety Autoland for the PC-12 PRO had received EASA and FAA certification. The aircraft uses the Garmin G3000 PRIME integrated flight deck.
The system activates by button or on detection of pilot inactivity. It assesses weather, aircraft status, navigation information and fuel to select an airport and a route that avoids terrain.

It manages flaps, landing gear, lights, de-icing and radio calls. Pilatus says certification testing covered activation through landing, communications and engine shutdown. Approval of the system does not establish that every aircraft has been retrofitted.

facts.claim: Pilatus dated announcement 2026-09-24: Safety Autoland certified by EASA and FAA.
PC-12 PRO flight deck is Garmin G3000 PRIME; activation by button or pilot inactivity.
System handles airport selection, landing systems, communications and engine shutdown.
